name: mission-control
summary: Route genuinely multi-part missions into the smallest sufficient skill graph with owners, gates, and evidence.
avoid_when: the user has not authorized consequential actions
workflow: stop when the requested outcome is verified

positive_example.request: $mission-control coordinate research, a decision memo, and a staged implementation for this launch.

negative_example.reason: A single direct response is sufficient.

name: automation-self-healer
summary: Diagnose a bounded automation failure, reproduce it, propose the smallest repair, and verify recovery without hiding incidents.
avoid_when: the failure cannot be reproduced or observed
the proposed repair would bypass safety controls
workflow: verify recovery and preserve the incident record

positive_example.request: $automation-self-healer reproduce this scheduled-job failure and propose a reversible fix.

negative_example.request: Silence the failing check so the workflow is green.

name: decision-memo-engine
summary: Turn evidence, constraints, alternatives, and uncertainty into an answer-first decision memo.
avoid_when: the task is only factual retrieval
the decision owner and objective are unknown

positive_example.request: Compare build, buy, and partner options and write an executive decision memo.

negative_example.request: Extract every heading from this document.
negative_example.reason: Extraction alone is not a decision.

name: experiment-autopilot
summary: Design a falsifiable, staged experiment with metrics, stopping rules, and a decision link.
avoid_when: the intervention creates unmanaged safety risk
the metric cannot answer the decision

positive_example.request: Design a two-week experiment to test whether onboarding reminders improve activation.

negative_example.request: Run an unreviewed experiment on all users immediately.
negative_example.reason: Execution requires risk review and staged rollout.

name: knowledge-graph-builder
summary: Convert a bounded evidence corpus into typed entities, claims, relations, provenance, and conflict-aware views.
avoid_when: the corpus has no stable identifiers
the user only needs a simple list
workflow: validate graph queries against source evidence

positive_example.request: Build a graph linking companies, products, claims, sources, and effective dates.

negative_example.request: Give me five bullet points from this article.
